title: Turbo Laps
description: Top-down racing on three twisty tracks. Three laps, four cars, and grass that will absolutely ruin your time. Drift through the bends, bump the CPU drivers, and race a friend on the same screen.
instructions: Player 1: W to accelerate, S to brake, A/D to steer. Player 2: the arrow keys. Solo? Arrows work too. Pick a track with the arrows on the menu (or Q and E). On a phone the gas is automatic: steer with the arrows and tap Brake.
